correctness.rationale: The proof correctly normalizes Haar measure and uses |gamma|=1. For ord χ>=7 or infinite, the seven frequency differences -3..3 are pairwise distinct, yielding s²+2Σ|R_h|² by Parseval. The outer and inner RMS pair estimates follow directly by Cauchy–Schwarz and AM–GM: |R1|≤2AB+B², |R2|≤2AB, |R3|≤A²; all can be sharp simultaneously. Writing t=A/B gives H(t) and H’(t)=−2(3t³+3t²−3t−1)/(1+t²)³. The cubic decreases only up to t=1/3, then strictly rises, has exactly one positive root rho≈0.7925172139743403 and gives global K≈2.808840165474397; both A=0 and B=0 give ratio at most 3/2. Equality demands a0=a3=A,a1=a2=B and common adjacent phase differences, giving precisely λ(rho,e^{iφ},e^{2iφ},rho e^{3iφ}). Direct exact cyclic-correlation enumeration at orders 4,5,6 with all coefficients one gives ratios 4,13/4,23/8>K. An independently written checker verified both derivative factorizations, the reciprocal parameterization of the earlier source, 1610 finite-group comparisons/sharp extremizers (largest direct-vs-correlation deviation 4.27e-14), and the exact small-grid witnesses. The finite checks corroborate, rather than replace, the universal algebraic proof.

value.rationale: Sharp L2-to-L4 constants on a four-frequency progression are naturally motivated, and the all-parameter theorem would be valuable if new. But the previous 2026-10-11 four-frequency publication fully establishes the same exact sharp constant and all equality cases; extending its grid/circle result by Haar pushforward does not add a novel invariant. The only remaining small-order nonstability assertion is certified by evaluating the all-ones four-tuple on three tiny cyclic grids. That calculation has no separately motivated structural insight, complete classification of those small orders, or substantive independent mathematical gap. Correctness and reproducibility of that finite witness do not confer research value. This rejection is based on full prior implication plus remaining content, not on a blanket bar against finite mathematics.

final_claim: The sharp normalized fourth moment of arbitrary complex coefficients on four consecutive characters of any compact abelian group with character order >=7 or infinite is K≈2.808840165474397, with complete optimizer family λ(rho,e^{iφ},e^{2iφ},rho e^{3iφ}); orders 4,5,6 violate K.
limitations: The conclusion is restricted to four consecutive distinct characters and a fourth-power moment; no constants are claimed for individual orders 4,5,6.
A finite random check or success log is not a proof of the unlimited compact-abelian theorem; the written symmetrization/Parseval proof is decisive.
The original Git blob byte streams were not all locally rehashed; the returned Git blob identities and reconstructed Git tree were independently checked, and current main listed matching blob IDs.
